methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Create a score on a completed run.

 A person rates a run with metric `feedback` and source
 score_source_human; each person rates a run once and changes the
 rating with update. The session and organization are taken from the
 run.

methods.name: Update
methods.description:
Update a score: the fields update_mask names change, every other
 field keeps its stored value.

 Only feedback is editable, only by the person who gave it, and only its
 value and comment; a check's verdict never changes.

 resource.metadata.id names the score; apply finds one by slug. The slug
 changes only through rename, and a mask naming a field another door
 owns, or a path the score does not have, is refused with
 INVALID_ARGUMENT naming the path.

 An update is refused with ABORTED carrying a google.rpc.ErrorInfo detail
 (domain "stigmer.ai"):

   - ETAG_MISMATCH — resource.metadata.etag is set and the score changed
     since that etag was read: read it again and make the change again.
     No metadata.
   - WRITE_CONFLICT — the score kept changing while the update was
     being saved: try again. No metadata.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete a score.

 A person deletes their own rating; the run's owner may delete any
 score on the run.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single score by ID.

methods.name: ListByRun
methods.description: List the scores of a run, newest first.

methods.name: ListBySession
methods.description: List the scores of every run in a session, newest first.

methods.name: GetAgentQualityReport
methods.description:
Get how one agent's runs in an organization went: grades counted in
 total, per day and per agent version.

 Counts every run of the agent in the organization, including runs the
 caller cannot open, and returns no text from any of them. Requires
 can_view on the organization named in org and on the agent.

methods.name: ListFlaggedByAgent
methods.description:
List the failed grades of one agent's runs in an organization, newest
 first: a failed health check, a failed judge verdict or a thumbs down.

 Lists only the runs the caller can open. Requires can_view on the
 organization named in org and on the agent.

methodTypes.name: UpdateScoreInput
methodTypes.description:
The changes an update makes to a score: the fields update_mask names,
 taken from resource.

fields.name: Resource
fields.description:
The score carrying the new values, named by metadata.id. Only the fields
 update_mask names are read, so the others may be left empty; the result
 is validated as a whole.

fields.name: UpdateMask
fields.description:
The paths the update changes, as proto field names (spec.instructions,
 metadata.labels). A list or map at a named path is replaced whole; "*"
 names every path an update may change.

methodTypes.name: ListScoresByRunRequest
methodTypes.description: ListScoresByRunRequest lists the scores of one run, newest first.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: ID of the run whose scores to list.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description:
The most entries to return: 0 asks for the default page of 50, and a
 size above 100 is read as 100.

fields.name: PageToken
fields.description:
The previous response's next_page_token, to continue that list; every
 other field must equal that request's, or the call is refused.

fields.name: Labels
fields.description:
Only resources carrying every label given, each matched exactly (AND).
 A selective filter may answer short pages, even empty ones, that still
 carry a token.

methodTypes.name: ScoreList
methodTypes.description: ScoreList is a list of scores.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: The scores, newest first.

fields.name: NextPageToken
fields.description:
Set when more entries may follow: pass it as page_token to continue.
 A page may be short, even empty, and still carry a token.

methodTypes.name: GetAgentQualityReportRequest
methodTypes.description:
GetAgentQualityReportRequest asks how one agent's runs in one
 organization went over the last few days.

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
Organization whose runs of the agent are counted. The caller must be
 able to view it; runs in other organizations are never counted.

fields.name: AgentId
fields.description:
ID of the agent whose runs are counted. The caller must be able to view
 it.

fields.name: Days
fields.description:
How many days to count, ending today, from 1 to 90. Zero counts the
 last 30. Days are UTC.

methodTypes.name: AgentQualityReport
methodTypes.description:
AgentQualityReport counts one agent's grades in one organization, in
 total, per day and per agent version.

fields.name: FromDate
fields.description: First day counted (UTC), as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: ToDate
fields.description: Last day counted (UTC, today), as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Total
fields.description: Every grade in the window.

fields.name: Days
fields.description:
One entry per UTC day that has a grade, oldest first. A grade counts on
 the day it was given.

fields.name: Versions
fields.description:
One entry per agent version that has a grade in the window, most
 recently seen first.

fields.name: Agreement
fields.description:
Where people's thumbs and the AI judge disagree, one entry per judge
 rubric version, most recently seen first. Only runs with both a judge
 grade and at least one thumbs in the window are counted.

methodTypes.description:

fields.name: AgentId

fields.name: Days

The most entries to return: 0 asks for the default page of 50, and a

The previous response's next_page_token, to continue that list; every
 other field must equal that request's, or the call is refused.

fields.name: Labels

enumTypes.name: ScoreState

values.name: score_state_pending

enumTypes.name: ApiResourceVisibility
enumTypes.description:
Visibility controls who can access an API resource.
 This is orthogonal to ownership - visibility is about access control,
 while ownership (org) determines who manages the resource.

 Key distinction:
 - Ownership: Which organization controls/manages the resource
 - Visibility: Who can access/use the resource

 All resources belong to an organization. Visibility determines which
 users, inside that organization or in its child organizations, can read
 the resource. No level reaches every
 account on the server.

 The visibility levels map to FGA tuples:
 - PRIVATE: no additional viewer tuples (owner-only access)
 - ORG: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer tuple (everyone in the
   org — the org role hierarchy flows downward, so owners, admins, members
   AND read-only viewers all satisfy the organization#viewer userset)
 - CHILD_ORGS: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer
   (everyone in every child organization of the owning organization)
 - PUBLIC: retired; see the value's own comment.

values.name: visibility_private
values.description:
Only the owner, explicitly granted principals, and — for blueprint kinds
 in the cloud edition — org admins can access.
 This is the default for personal and run-scoped resources.

 Org admins count as owners of blueprint kinds (agent, agent_share,
 skill, plugin), so a private blueprint stays
 manageable — and visible — to its org's admins. Personal kinds
 (sessions) stay creator-only.

values.name: visibility_public
values.description:
Retired. This level made a resource readable to every account on the
 server; it is refused at create and at updateVisibility for every kind,
 and every stored row that held it has been moved to visibility_org.
 Sharing across organizations happens through plugins (a copy is
 installed and owned) or, from a parent organization to its children,
 through visibility_child_orgs.

values.name: visibility_org
values.description:
Everyone in the owning organization can access (read) this resource —
 all org roles including read-only viewers (the role just-in-time provisioning
 grants by default). Running or otherwise spending against the resource
 still requires the org-level member-or-guest permissions
 (can_create_session / can_create_run_in); org visibility widens
 read, never spend.

 FGA tuple: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer
 (The tuple once targeted organization#member, which
 excluded viewer-role users; the authorization model no longer admits
 that shape.)

values.name: visibility_child_orgs
values.description:
Everyone in every child organization of the owning organization can
 read and run this resource: the shared catalog an organization offers
 the organizations under it (spec.parent_org). Child organizations
 created later gain access automatically, and no other organization
 does. Instances, sessions, runs and vaults are never shared
 this way: each child runs the shared blueprint inside its own boundary.

 Only valid for blueprint kinds with supports_child_orgs: true, and only
 in an organization that is not itself a child.

 FGA tuple: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer

enumTypes.name: ScoreSource
enumTypes.description: ScoreSource names who or what gave a score.

values.name: score_source_check
values.description:
A free check the platform runs on every completed run, with no model
 call.

values.name: score_source_human
values.description: A person who can see the run.

values.name: score_source_judge
values.description:
An AI judge grading the run against Stigmer's standard rubrics, switched
 on per agent by its evaluator.

values.name: score_source_eval
values.description:
A plugin's own eval: one try of one evals/ case, graded by the case's
 checks.

values.name: criterion_result_failed
values.description: The run did not meet the criterion; the reason says how.

values.name: criterion_result_not_applicable
values.description: The criterion does not apply to this run.

resourceDescription:
Score is one grade of a finished run.

 A run carries a score for each thing measured: a person's thumbs up or
 down on the final answer, the free run-health checks the platform runs
 when a run completes, and an AI judge's verdict where the run's agent has
 AI grading switched on. Anyone who can see the run sees its scores.

statusType.name: ScoreStatus
statusType.description: ScoreStatus contains system-managed state for a score.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Whether the score carries a grade.

fields.name: NotGradedReason
fields.description: Why the run could not be graded, when state is not graded.

fields.name: AgentId
fields.description:
ID of the agent the scored run ran, copied from the run when the score
 is created. Empty for a run of the built-in assistant.

fields.name: AgentVersionHash
fields.description:
Content hash of the agent version the scored run ran, copied from the
 run when the score is created. Unique only within its agent; empty when
 agent_id is empty or the agent had no recorded version.

fields.name: Audit
fields.description: Standard audit information (created_at, updated_at, created_by, etc.)

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
statusNestedTypes.description:
ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

 This is the platform's single actor vocabulary: every "who did this"
 reference (created_by / updated_by, version-history applied_by / pushed_by,
 approval resolved_by_actor) uses this message, so actor rendering is
 uniform across all surfaces.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description:
Human-readable display name (e.g. "Ada Lovelace"). Empty when unknown;
 renderers fall back to email, then id.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address of the actor. Empty when unknown or not applicable
 (e.g. machine accounts).

fields.name: PlatformClientId
fields.description:
The PlatformClient whose minted user token the actor acted through.
 Empty for every other credential, and on an actor that records no act
 (an account's profile lookup).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").
